Chemical peels have long been a trusted, effective solution for improving skin health and appearance. At Boston Medical Aesthetics , we offer the VI Peel , a powerful, medical-grade chemical peel known for producing real, noticeable results with minimal downtime . Whether you're dealing with acne, pigmentation, aging skin, or uneven texture, there's a VI Peel that can help you achieve glowing, radiant skin. What is a Chemical Peel? A chemical peel uses a targeted solution to exfoliate the top layers of the skin, promoting cell turnover and revealing the fresh, healthy skin beneath. This process improves tone, texture, and clarity- giving your skin a more youthful, vibrant appearance. Why Choose the VI Peel? The VI Peel is one of the most versatile and effective chemical peels available. It's safe for all skin tones and types , offers little downtime , and treats a wide range of skin concerns in a single treatment. With multiple formulations available, each one is tailored to address specific concerns while enhancing the overall quality of your skin. Types of VI Peels & What They Treat ✦ VI Peel Original Ideal for first-time peelers or those with sensitive skin. Treats: Early signs of aging, rough texture, and dullness. ✦ VI Peel Precision Plus Targets stubborn pigmentation and melasma. Treats: Sun damage, age spots, discoloration, and melasma. ✦ VI Peel Purify Created for those struggling with acne. Treats: Breakouts, acne scarring, inflammation, and excess oil. ✦ VI Peel Purify with Precision Plus Combines acne-fighting ingredients with pigmentation correction. Treats: Active acne and post-acne marks, all in one treatment. ✦ VI Peel Body Designed for use on larger areas of the body such as the back, chest, arms, or buttocks. Treats: Body acne, scars, sun damage, keratosis pilaris, and rough skin texture. Introducing the TOXBooster™ Treatment A Peel + Tox Combo for Maximum Results If you're looking to take your results to the next level, the TOXBooster™ may be the perfect fit. This innovative treatment combines a VI Peel with a neurotoxin injection (such as Botox or Dysport ) in a single appointment. The VI Peel exfoliates and primes the skin, allowing the neuromodulator to work more effectively. In clinical studies, TOXBooster™ treatments resulted in a 36% reduction in wrinkles after just one session- a noticeable improvement in both skin quality and expression lines. This powerhouse combo is ideal for those looking to smooth fine lines while refreshing the entire face. Who is a Good Candidate? VI Peels are suitable for most people and all skin types. You may benefit from a VI Peel if you're looking to improve: Acne or acne scars Sun damage or dark spots Uneven tone or rough texture Fine lines and wrinkles Enlarged pores Skin dullness or congestion Body blemishes or discoloration Why We Love It at Boston Medical Aesthetics At Boston Medical Aesthetics, VI Peels are one of our go-to treatments because they work. Whether you want to tackle stubborn skin concerns or maintain a youthful glow, VI Peels are safe, reliable, and deliver real results . They're also incredibly versatile, working beautifully on the face, neck, chest, back, and more. Plus, they pair well with other treatments like injectables , or laser therapies for an even greater transformation. Ready to Glow? If you're curious about chemical peels , we invite you to schedule a complimentary consultation with one of our expert providers. We'll help you determine which VI Peel is best for your skin type and goals and if you're ready for a more advanced treatment, we can also discuss TOXBooster™ or combination therapies for optimal results. Let's create a treatment plan that leaves you feeling confident, refreshed, and radiant with our Boston med spa team guiding every VI Peel journey .
